title.en: Adjusting the Retirement Pension of Officers and Enlisted Personnel or Survivors of Deceased Personnel Retired or Separated Prior To January 1, 1976

text.en:
The rates of retirement pensions of gratuity of Commissioned officers and enlisted personnel of the
Armed Forces of the Philippines or the survivors of deceased personnel who retired or were separated prior to
January 1, 1976 as provided for in Republic Act Numbered 340 shall be increased by absolute amounts
equivalent to fifty percentum of the difference between pension rates for each grade based on military pay
prescribed in Presidential Decree No. 854 and General Order No. 11 including the increase based on Budget
Circular No. 240.

The Secretary of National Defense shall promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary
to implement the intent and purpose of this Decree.

The sum of twenty-three million pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in
the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, in addition to the current budget of the Armed Forces of the
Philippines and shall hereafter be included in the annual appropriations of the Armed Forces of the
Philippines, provisions of existing laws to the contrary notwithstanding.

This decree shall take effect upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and

seventy-six.
